headline: Netherlands to Invest USD 500 Million in Brazil's Tropical Forest Fund
summary: The Dutch government announced an intention to invest USD 500 million over 10 years in the Tropical Forest Forever Facility, an international financing mechanism conceived by Brazil.
why: The Tropical Forest Forever Facility is an international financing initiative aimed at forest conservation and climate change mitigation, launched at the UN Climate Change Conference (COP30).

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Receives long-term international funding for environmental conservation.
